data.title: Edding Genor Posts Promising Phase I Data for Trispecific Cancer Antibody GB268
data.description:
The latest update is out from Genor Biopharma Holdings Limited ( (HK:6998) ).

Edding Genor reported preliminary first-in-human Phase I data for its trispecific antibody GB268, which was presented at the ESMO Congress 2026. The study evaluated GB268 as a single agent in previously treated patients with advanced solid tumors, focusing on safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics and early antitumor activity.

GB268 demonstrated encouraging antitumor activity in HR+/HER2- breast cancer, ovarian cancer and non-small cell lung cancer, including typically immunologically cold tumors and patients previously exposed to targeted therapies and immunotherapy. Responses were observed even in low PD-L1 expression populations, and the drug was generally well tolerated across the 1–40 mg/kg dose range with no maximum tolerated dose reached and no new safety signals identified, underscoring its potential to strengthen the company’s oncology portfolio.
